name: Loss or theft of customer crypto assets
description: Hot-wallet hack, key-management failure, malicious insider with custody access, or compromised cold-storage operation results in irreversible loss of customer crypto.

name: Inbound transfer from sanctioned wallet
description: Customer receives crypto from a sanctioned address, mixer, or OFAC-listed entity. Without on-chain screening you process and credit the funds, breaching sanctions law.

name: Money laundering via layered crypto transactions
description: Bad actors layer illicit funds through your platform using multiple wallets, peeling chains, or chain-hopping to obscure origin. Detected only post-event without behavioural monitoring.

name: Travel-rule failure on outbound transfer
description: Outbound transfer to another CASP/VASP without exchanging required originator/beneficiary data. Regulatory breach + receiving CASP may freeze funds.

name: Market manipulation on listed tokens
description: Wash trading, spoofing, or insider activity on tokens you list. MiCA market-abuse regime applies; you have surveillance obligations.

name: Fraudulent fiat deposits + crypto withdrawal (cash-out)
description: Stolen cards or compromised bank accounts fund a customer; they immediately convert to crypto and withdraw — irreversibly. Chargebacks land on the CASP.

name: Listed token turns out to be a rug-pull or scam
description: Token you listed collapses (developer exit, smart-contract exploit, abandoned project). Customer losses + reputational damage + potential regulatory action.
